issues.failure_explanation: For the backward parabolic equation -\mathcal{L}u - f_\lambda = 0, the viscosity supersolution condition at a local minimum of V^\lambda - \phi requires -\mathcal{L}\phi - f_\lambda \ge 0, or equivalently \mathcal{L}\phi + f_\lambda \le 0. The proof in (3.2) mistakenly writes \ge 0. Then, from the resulting inequality 0 \le \mathcal{L}p_b + f + (\lambda - K_y)\ell + \dots, the proof deduces (\lambda - K_y)\ell \le -(\mathcal{L}p_b + f) + \dots, which is an invalid inference (reversing the inequality direction from 0 \le A + B). Setting the correct supersolution inequality \le 0 in (3.2) properly justifies the desired upper bound on (\lambda - K_y)\ell.
issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Correct the viscosity supersolution condition in (3.2) to -\mathcal{L}\phi - f_\lambda \ge 0 (i.e., \mathcal{L}\phi + f_\lambda \le 0) and carry through the valid algebraic deduction to conclude (\lambda - K_y)\ell \le -(\mathcal{L}p_b + f).
issues.overall_effect: The proof of Proposition 3.3 contains an invalid definition of the viscosity supersolution inequality paired with an algebraically invalid inequality flip; although the asserted bound is correct once the sign is repaired, the argument as written does not logically establish it.
issues.title: Invalid viscosity supersolution inequality and subsequent sign-reversal inference in Proposition 3.3
issues.why_classification: A direct, local sign correction in the viscosity supersolution step repairs the inference without requiring any new lemmas or changing any results, rates, or guarantees in the paper.

issues.failure_explanation: Corollary 4.4 establishes the total error bound C_2(\lambda \Delta t^{1/2} + \lambda^{-1}). The prose claims that choosing \lambda = \Delta t^{-1/2} yields the minimal error rate O(\Delta t^{1/4}). However, evaluating the bound at \lambda = \Delta t^{-1/2} gives \lambda \Delta t^{1/2} + \lambda^{-1} = \Delta t^{-1/2}\Delta t^{1/2} + \Delta t^{1/2} = 1 + \Delta t^{1/2} = O(1), which does not converge to 0 as \Delta t \to 0. The balancing choice that minimizes \lambda \Delta t^{1/2} + \lambda^{-1} and attains O(\Delta t^{1/4}) is \lambda \asymp \Delta t^{-1/4}, not \lambda = \Delta t^{-1/2}.
issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Replace the tuning specification \lambda = \Delta t^{-1/2} by \lambda = \Delta t^{-1/4} in Contribution 3 of the Introduction and in the prose remark immediately following Corollary 4.4.
issues.overall_effect: The claimed parameter coupling \lambda = \Delta t^{-1/2} fails to balance the bound and produces an O(1) error bound instead of the advertised O(\Delta t^{1/4}) rate for the general driver case.
issues.title: Erroneous penalty parameter tuning choice stated for general driver mean-square error
issues.why_classification: The formal bound in Corollary 4.4 is correct, and replacing the miscalculated tuning choice \lambda = \Delta t^{-1/2} with the correct minimizer \lambda = \Delta t^{-1/4} immediately preserves the claimed O(\Delta t^{1/4}) rate.
